regulations.notes: No new tourist lodging permits are issued in R-1, R-2, or R-3 residential zones — STRs are effectively banned in residential areas. STRs are only allowed in commercial and tourism zones. An Arkansas state bill (2025) proposed prohibiting localities from banning STRs outright, which could override Eureka Springs' restrictions if passed.
regulations.pending_legislation: Arkansas state bill to preempt local STR bans (2025 session)
